description: Persist a signed execution declaration receipt. Public price: 0.002 USDC via x402 on the advertised network. Preserve event, idempotencyKey and payment authorization on retries. Signed declarations do not independently prove execution.

event.description: Commitment-only declaration of one execution step.

agentId.description: Identifier of the declaring agent, not an independently verified identity.

completedAt.description: Declared completion in UTC with milliseconds, at or after start.

inputHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact input bytes, computed locally. Never send raw input.

digest.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; SHA-256 of exact bytes.

outcome.description: Outcome declared by the caller; Datoka does not observe execution.

outputHash.description: SHA-256 of exact output bytes, computed locally. Never send raw output.

digest.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; SHA-256 of exact bytes.

runId.description: Stable identifier for this execution run.

startedAt.description: Declared start time in UTC, with milliseconds.

stepId.description: Stable identifier of the step within the run.

tool.description: Tool or operation identifier declared by the caller.

version.description: Declaration format version; preserve this literal.

idempotencyKey.description: Persist this unique key before purchase. Reuse unchanged with the same input and payment authorization after interruption.

name: issue_agent_receipt
title: Issue Agent Receipt
